rawBlockNode.name: heroTitle
rawBlockNode.content: Durable user terminals for mission-critical operations

children.name: heroTitle
children.content: Durable user terminals for mission-critical operations

rawBlockNode.name: sec1desc
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta is changing the way the world connects. Kymeta offers the first electronically scanning, flat-panel satellite terminal for fixed and mobile platforms. Combined with our global, high-bandwidth services and world class support, we offer a complete connectivity solution so you can stay connected wherever in the world you go.

children.name: sec1desc
children.content: Kymeta is changing the way the world connects. Kymeta offers the first electronically scanning, flat-panel satellite terminal for fixed and mobile platforms. Combined with our global, high-bandwidth services and world class support, we offer a complete connectivity solution so you can stay connected wherever in the world you go.

children.name: p1desc
children.content: The Kymeta Osprey is all-purpose defense and government operation with resilient, integrated, and always-connected communications-on-the-move capabilities.

children.name: p2desc
children.content: Able to switch dynamically between LEO, GEO and cellular networks, this turnkey satellite user terminal offers enterprise uptime, robust and durable hardware suitable for security and intelligence agencies.

children.name: p3desc
children.content: Stay connected even in rough conditions on the open ocean. Instant waterway, or more flow. The Peregrine u8 seamlessly integrates with your vessel's IT infrastructure.

children.name: acc1Desc
children.content: Hard-shell cases with tie-down points safely and securely transport terminal systems. Rugged construction ensures reliable protection during transport.

children.name: acc2Desc
children.content: Mounting systems attach terminal hardware to poles, roof racks, and marine vessels so equipment is secured for stationary or on-the-move operation.

children.name: acc3Desc
children.content: AC and DC power kits include everything needed to connect terminal systems to vehicle or building power infrastructure.
